QuestInfo.name: Tae Soo Protecting the Peach Tree
QuestInfo.0: The proud protector of Peach Farm, #b#p2091003##k, has something he really wants...
QuestInfo.1: #p2091003# wants to find a medicine that really speeds up the growth of Peach Tree. #p2091002# is a master at making these medicines, but he can't ask the owner of the Peach Farm to make the medicine for him, so he's asking me to get #b#t4031554##k from #b#p2090004##k...\n\n#i4031554##t4031554#  #b#c4031554##k/1
QuestInfo.2: I was able to obtain the medicine from #p2090004# and gave it to #p2091003#. Phew. Making a medicine through #p2090004# must be much more difficult than protecting the great Peach Tree.

0.0: You must be a traveler, right? Great to see you! What's your first impression on #m250000000#? Don't you think this town seems very peaceful and serene? It's not uncommon to find people who are totally content with their lives, training diligently to become a true Master. I might be the only one here who's always concerned about something.
0.1: What am I worried about? Well, I'm the official protector of this great Peach Farm. Many people think we have nothing to do, and just sit down, lie down, and chat with the neighbors, but that's so not true. We're really busy, as a matter of fact. The problem is, Peach Farm is always saddled with animals looking to steal some Peaches from the Farm. Can you help me out if you can?

yes.0: It's not a difficult task actually. So many creatures have plucked the Peaches from the farm, and as a result, the Peach Tree isn't growing like it's supposed to. That's why I've decided to give the tree a 'supplement,' and I want you to get #t4031554# for me and for the trees.
yes.1: I have to warn you, though, PLEASE don't ask #p2091002# for this. #p2091002# is the best pharmacist here in #m250000000#, but is also the owner of the Peach Farm. He will not be pleased if he hears that I plan on giving the Peach Tree some boost. That's why, although I can't completely trust him, please ask #p2090004# for the medicine. Thank you!

no.0: Well, I mean... maybe I asked a wrong person for this. After all, you may be swamped with visiting #m250000000#.
